truthOwnership: none; composes authority, cognition, effect, transfer, and presentation owners without redefining them
rules: every decision-bearing presentation is representable as one cognitive envelope
each abstraction retains stable downward evidence/provenance handles and explicit upward mission relevance
knowledge state, provenance, coverage, omissions, budget, authority, and affordances survive every transport and compression boundary
public semantic operations have one registry and identical meaning across CLI, Rust API, MCP, TUI, and reports
effect commitment is impossible from free-form prose and requires a prepared digest plus current witnesses
learning remains advisory until explicit evidence-gated promotion
SituationCapsule is the primary read object; SituationFrame is its inner minimum sufficient world projection; ContextPack is only a budget-shaped materialization and never a rival truth surface

SituationFrame carries the evidence/possibility WorldEnvelope; SituationCapsule adds the control envelope, so the agent sees what is established, what remains possible, and what is safe to do in one publication

ContractBasis and AgentRequestEnvelope define one request lifecycle; AgentCognitiveEnvelope contains semantic meaning; AgentResponseEnvelope adds effective authority/privacy/view, task lifecycle, retry, proof, budget, payload integrity, and continuation without redefining meaning

hydrationLevels.name: identity
hydrationLevels.content: digest, type, time/spatial bounds, source, availability, cost, and authority

hydrationLevels.name: semantic_synopsis
hydrationLevels.content: typed facts, knowledge states, provenance, contradictions, quality, and omissions

hydrationLevels.name: decision_artifact
hydrationLevels.content: authorized redacted keyframes, crops, trajectories, graph neighborhoods, or audio features

hydrationLevels.name: source_evidence
hydrationLevels.content: authorized original encoded packets, object bytes, exact metadata, or full-resolution media

hydrationLevels.name: laboratory_expansion
hydrationLevels.content: replay bundle, intermediates, alternate decoders/models, and oracle comparisons

layers.name: runtime_authority_and_custody
layers.question: What work, authority, budget, identity, time, and object custody exist?
layers.output: Context, grants, regions, obligations, object roots, and receipts.
layers.prohibition: Cannot infer mission meaning or physical truth.

layers.name: source_evidence
layers.question: What exact packets, files, measurements, continuity, and capture-time intervals exist?
layers.output: Immutable sensor capsules, source objects, continuity and time evidence.
layers.prohibition: Cannot promote decode or model output into source evidence.

layers.name: world_facts_and_coverage
layers.question: What did the system authoritatively observe or do at one anchor?
layers.output: Device, geometry, calibration, coverage, policy, archive, and effect facts.
layers.prohibition: Cannot include unqualified cognition as fact.

layers.name: derived_beliefs
layers.question: What entities, tracks, events, relations, and uncertainties are supported?
layers.output: Generation-pinned derived beliefs and graph/search projections with receipts.
layers.prohibition: Cannot authorize effects or certify absence beyond coverage.

layers.name: situation_capsule
layers.question: What is the smallest sufficient mission-relative driver view now, what changed, and what can safely be done next?
layers.output: SituationCapsule containing SituationFrame with WorldEnvelope, MeaningfulDelta, obligations, resource state, categorized control envelope, ContextPack, compression proof, and affordance frontier.
layers.prohibition: Cannot hide decision-changing omissions or rebase evidence identities.

layers.name: investigation_and_hypotheses
layers.question: Which competing explanations remain viable and how can they be discriminated?
layers.output: Case revision, hypotheses, support, contradictions, predicted observations, falsifiers, and stop rule.
layers.prohibition: Cannot collapse uncertainty into truth without adjudication.

layers.name: affordance_frontier
layers.question: What can be done next, under current capability and budget, and why is it worth doing?
layers.output: Pareto frontier of read/control affordances with VOI, cost, risk, reversibility, invalidators, and proof.
layers.prohibition: Cannot grant authority or use one opaque score.

layers.name: plan_and_effect
layers.question: Which witnessed contingent DAG should run and did each effect happen?
layers.output: Prepared plan, commit ticket, effect receipts, obligation states, and reconciliation path.
layers.prohibition: Cannot execute prose or count dispatch as success.

layers.name: outcome_and_episode
layers.question: What was predicted, executed, observed, consumed, and left uncertain?
layers.output: Immutable execution episode with attribution hypotheses and resource ledger.
layers.prohibition: Cannot rewrite original predictions after outcome.

layers.name: learning_and_memory
layers.question: What reusable rule, anti-pattern, fixture, or runbook improvement should be proposed?
layers.output: Evidence-linked scoped proposal with counterexamples, harmful outcomes, validation, and expiry.
layers.prohibition: Cannot self-promote into active policy or truth.

layers.name: workspace_and_handoff
layers.question: How can this mission resume or transfer without rediscovery or hidden staleness?
layers.output: Versioned workspace revision and root-last HandoffCapsule.
layers.prohibition: Cannot preserve hidden conversational state or confer effect authority through custody.

responseComposition.rule: SituationCapsule is the primary orient/resume publication and contains the mission-relative SituationFrame plus meaningful delta, obligations, resource state, affordances, and context/compression proof. AgentCognitiveEnvelope is the general decision-bearing semantic payload. AgentResponseEnvelope adds lifecycle/retry/budget/proof/continuation framing without redefining meaning.
responseComposition.robustnessRule: ranked effect affordances are robust across all protected material worlds or explicitly conditional on named worlds and discriminating evidence
responseComposition.effectiveProjection: effective view + capabilities + privacy projection + task state + payload digest

requestComposition.authorityRule: requested capabilities/privacy/view are upper bounds only; the server computes and returns the effective intersection
requestComposition.rule: No CLI, MCP, Rust API, TUI, report, or future UI may invent a second request lifecycle or interpret free-form prose as a commit-capable payload.
